title: Walsh characters and field pairings
statement: Let $d,n,\ell,t$ be natural numbers with $\ell\ne0$. Let $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^d$, let $a=(a_i)_{i=0}^{d-1}$ be elements of the binary extension field of degree $\ell$, and let $s$ be an element of that field. Choose a basis to identify the field with $\mathbb F_2^\ell$, and let the field pairing generator have $i$th coordinate the binary dot product of the coordinate vectors of $a_i$ and $s$. The Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$ evaluated at this generated vector equals the Walsh character indexed by the coordinate vector of $\sum_{i=0}^{d-1}\gamma_i a_i$, evaluated at the coordinate vector of $s$.
hypotheses_covered: A family of field elements $a_i$ indexed by $i<d$
